items.text: MCD wants safety certificates from 2,400+ PGs within 15 days. Ask your owner if yours is checked.
Half marathon Sun: Red, Yellow, Blue, Violet lines from 3:30 am. Plan central trips after noon.
Jantar Mantar is no longer an approved protest site; Ramlila, Burari and CBD Grounds replace it.
DU students flagged dark stretches at Siri Fort Rd and Mukherjee Nagar. In an emergency, dial 112.
E-bus charging opened at Anand Vihar ISBT, Rohini Sec-37, Nangloi, Keshopur depots; 150 e-buses due.
211 clean-air days so far, best since 2016. Winter smog usually hits in November; plan for it.
